dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a sharp falcate curve from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Highly acute apex with a minimal pixel radius, ending in a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep positive gradient approximately 70 degrees relative to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Narrow profile with a height-to-base ratio of approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, parabolic convexity transitioning into a defined rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical beak with high thickness relative to the visible length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees where the melon meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white lesion or pigment mark on the dorsal fin; several light-colored circular patches visible on the lateral flank and head region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced polygonal segmentation along the silhouette edges and sharp specular highlights on the rostrum and melon.
